en: Color-tinted historic postcard view of a large circular public square/park with curved paths, trees without leaves, low hedges, and a small pond. A horse-drawn carriage moves along the broad road in the foreground, with a few pedestrians walking nearby. Surrounding the square are late-19th/early-20th‑century townhouses and larger buildings, and church spires rise in the background. The captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen" on the left and "Keizer Karel Plein" on the right in red letters.
